title: 第11章 恶有恶报第12章 返回东河
lines: “行，您说！”随着高山的话语落下，曹天赐顿时眼前一亮，立刻就答应了下来。
那种折磨，只有曹天赐母子两人知道。只要高山能松口，别说三个条件了，哪怕是更多他都能答应。
“第一，我们不能这么平白无故的私了吧。既然已经通过交警队了，那就只能在交警队进行调解处理。”高山说到。
这一个条件，曹天赐想都没想，直接就点头道：“好，没有问题。”
高山继续道：“第二，既然已经请了记者了。那么记者还是要继续请过来。我要让人知道，我爸没撞人。”
这一点让曹天赐有些为难了。没撞人，那不就是他们母子两人讹人了么？可是，曹天赐咬了咬牙，还是点头答应了下来：“好！”
高山也不怕曹天赐不答应。继续道：“第三，我家垫付了两万的费用。我爸的车子还扣押在交警队。这些损失你们必须要承担。另外，还得赔偿。我也不多要，加上我们垫付的钱，一共赔偿五万。不过分吧。”
什么以德报怨，什么息事宁人；高山是绝不会那么做的。这也就是自己没时间跟他耗，要不然就不是这么一点钱可以打发了。可怜之人必有可恨之处。别看这母子两人现在似乎很惨。可如果不是高山有这传承。那这对母子恐怕就不是这么简单了。昨天的调解，那可是亲耳听到了的。曹天赐开口就是百万赔偿。换成他们得势的话，只有更狠。
前面两个条件曹天赐答应得十分的爽快，唯独到了钱这份上，曹天赐反而是犹豫了。可最终还是点头道：“好。我答应了。”
第二天一早，曹天赐又把昨天的记者朋友们都请了过来。还是在三大队事故处理中队调解办公室的门口。来自庆德市本地，还有定南卫视的记者媒体大大小小五六家媒体都已经到场了。
看到曹天赐母子坐着轮椅车，被人推进来。有些不明就里，不知道昨天事情本末的记者立刻就低声道：“这是什么情况？一次撞翻了两个么？难道说肇事者家里有矿，有背景？这是仗势欺人么？”
“嗯，有矿。有泥土矿！你嘴巴里面的肇事者，天天都要挖矿。面朝黄土背朝天。”昨天那正义感爆棚的女记者立刻就怼了起来。
犀利的话语直接就让人无比的尴尬。昨天也全程参与了的一个男记者立刻就低声道：“别多心，不是对你呢。实在是刚才进去的这两人太无耻，太没有道德了。”
说着，男记者巴拉巴拉就把昨天的事情完整的复述了一遍。语言生动、描述精准，简直就如同实况录像一样。
省台的记者顿时恍然大悟，脸上也露出了愤怒：“这种人实在是太可耻了。如今这个社会就是这种人把整个社会风气都搞坏了。就因为这群人。让社会的公信力几乎丧失。扶不扶、扶不起已经成为社会问题了。我们就应该把这种人曝光出去。”
女记者很是满意同行的这种态度，应声附和道：“说得不错。昨天我们可是亲眼看着这对母子好生生的走出去的，今天还坐轮椅来了。这是装给谁看呢？博取同情么？”
上午九点十分左右，高山就和老爸一起赶到了这边。高庆国的脸色有些凝重，这件事他背负着不小的精神压力。明显可以看出他苍老了许多。
随着两人的到来，女记者立刻就挥舞手臂，做出一个给力加油的手势，大声道：“高先生，加油。我们都支持你。千万不要让那对母子得逞。”
一走进会议室，就在众人都还没准备好的情况之下，曹天赐母子就直接站了起来。两人动作整齐划一。齐整整的扑通一声，跪在了高山和高庆国的前面。
刘桂香更是声泪俱下道：“高家老弟啊。实在是对不起，是我老糊涂了。错把好人当恶人啊。我这脑子不清楚。现在我想清楚了。我是自己过马路的时候，不小心踩错台阶这才摔倒了。”
刘桂香母子这突然的动作，一下就让所有人都懵了。陈警官也是瞪大着眼睛，嘴巴微微张开，惊讶得半天没有说话。他处理交通事故没有十年也有八年了。还真没见到过良心发现的。
尤其是像现在这种情况。这简直是天下少有啊。这还是昨天那个耍泼打滚的女人么？怎么看着不像啊。
陈警官反应很快，直接道：“刘桂香，曹天赐。你们干什么？这又是玩的什么鬼把戏。我警告你们。说话都是要负责任的。你们的话已经全部被录下来了。这就跟高老哥他们没有关系了。”
这话听着仿佛是在为刘桂香他们做维护。实际这是一种确认。只要曹天赐母子再次确认。那即便再变卦也没有用了。不管有没有监控视频，不管有没有证人。作为当事人在没有任何人胁迫的情况下承认的事情，那就可以作为证据使用了。
曹天赐苦笑起来，他倒是想敲诈一笔啊。可高家这小子太邪门了。昨天晚上他整整被折磨了一夜。口吐白沫。浑身抽搐的画面他至今都是记忆犹新的。这还能讹么？就怕是有命赚，没命花啊。
“陈队，您说笑了。我们是认真的。这几天实在是冤枉高大叔了。我也混账，做了一些不该做的事情，说了一些不该说的话。还请高大叔原谅啊。”曹天赐连连道歉。
陈警官没有再说了，而是点头道：“那行，那我来写调解协议吧。你们有什么诉求？”
曹天赐立刻道：“没有，没有任何的诉求。我妈住院的两万块钱我们自己出，除此之外，为了表示我们的歉意。我愿意赔偿高大叔三万块钱。”
随着陈警官开始做调解协议，曹天赐母子也都起来了。曹天赐此刻更是凑到了高山的旁边，有些小心翼翼的看着高山，道：“高老弟……你看…”
高山微笑着道：“我看什么？既然你都这么说了，我自然是没有什么意见的。你以后要是多做好事，自然就不会有什么问题了。”
说到这，高山拍了拍曹天赐的肩膀，又走到了刘桂香的面前，轻轻拍了一下刘桂香的肩膀，似笑非笑着道：“刘老太太，以后这脑子可要清楚一点。再讹人可就不好啦。”
高山可不会觉得不好意思。恶有恶报，就这两母子这种心性。这都算是轻的了。
content_en:
"Okay, you say it!" As Gao Shan finished speaking, Cao Tianci's eyes suddenly lit up and he immediately agreed.
Only Cao Tianci, mother and son, knew about that kind of torture. As long as Gao Shan can relent, let alone three conditions, he can agree to even more.
"First, we can't be so private for no reason. Now that it has passed the traffic police team, we can only mediate it in the traffic police team." Gao Shan said.
Cao Tianci didn't even think about this condition, he just nodded and said: "Okay, no problem."
Gao Shan continued: "Second, since we have invited reporters, we still need to continue to invite reporters. I want people to know that my dad did not hit anyone."
This made Cao Tianci a little embarrassed. If they didn't hit anyone, wouldn't it mean that the mother and son were blackmailing them? However, Cao Tianci gritted his teeth and nodded in agreement: "Okay!"
Gao Shan was not afraid that Cao Tianci would not agree. He continued: "Third, my family paid 20,000 yuan in advance. My dad's car is still impounded by the traffic police. You must bear these losses. In addition, you have to compensate. I don't want more, plus the money we paid in advance, the total compensation is 50,000 yuan. It's not excessive."
What is repaying evil with kindness, and what is peace of mind? Gao Shan would never do that. This means that I don't have time to spend with him, otherwise I wouldn't have such a little money to spend. Poor people must be hateful. Don't look at it, the mother and son seem to be miserable now. But if Gao Shan didn't have this inheritance. Then this mother and son may not be that simple. I heard the mediation yesterday with my own ears. Cao Tianci asked for compensation of one million yuan. If they had gained the upper hand, they would have been even more ruthless.
Cao Tianci readily agreed to the first two conditions, but when it came to the money, Cao Tianci hesitated. But in the end he nodded and said, "Okay. I agree."
Early the next morning, Cao Tianci invited all the reporter friends from yesterday. Still at the door of the mediation office of the accident handling squadron of the third brigade. Reporters from Qingde City as well as Dingnan TV and five or six media outlets, large and small, were already present.
I saw Cao Tianci and her son being pushed in in wheelchairs. A reporter who was a little confused and didn't know the whole story of yesterday's incident immediately whispered: "What is going on? Did they knock over two at once? Could it be that the perpetrator has a mine at home and a background? Is this bullying others?"
"Well, there are mines. There are soil mines! The perpetrator in your mouth has to dig for mines every day. With his face facing the loess and his back to the sky." Yesterday, the female reporter with a strong sense of justice immediately started to quarrel.
The sharp words directly make people extremely embarrassed. A male reporter who also participated in the whole process yesterday immediately whispered: "Don't worry too much, it's not for you. It's really that the two people who came in just now were too shameless and immoral."
With that said, the male reporter Balabala recounted what happened yesterday completely. The language is vivid and the descriptions are precise, almost like a live video.
The reporter from the provincial station suddenly realized, and his face also showed anger: "This kind of people are really shameful. In today's society, it is this kind of people who have ruined the entire social atmosphere. Because of this group of people, the credibility of society has almost been lost. Whether to help or not to help has become a social issue. We should expose this kind of people."
The female reporter was very satisfied with the attitude of her colleagues and echoed: "That's right. Yesterday we watched the mother and son walk out happily, and today they came in a wheelchair. Who are you pretending to show? Are you trying to gain sympathy?"
At about 9:10 in the morning, Gao Shan arrived here with his father. Gao Qingguo's face was a little solemn. He was under a lot of mental pressure from this matter. It was obvious that he was much older.
As the two people arrived, the female reporter immediately waved her arms, made a cheering gesture, and said loudly: "Mr. Gao, come on. We all support you. Don't let that mother and son succeed."
As soon as they entered the conference room, before everyone was ready, Cao Tianci and his son stood up directly. The two of them moved in unison. With a plop, they knelt in front of Gao Shan and Gao Qingguo.
Liu Guixiang burst into tears and said, "Brother from the Gao family, I'm really sorry. I was so confused. I mistook good people for evil people. My mind was not clear. Now I think clearly. When I was crossing the road, I accidentally stepped on the wrong step and fell."
The sudden movement of Liu Guixiang and her son made everyone confused. Officer Chen also had his eyes widened and his mouth slightly opened. He was so surprised that he didn't speak for a long time. He has been dealing with traffic accidents for eight to eight years. I’ve never seen anyone discovered by conscience.
Especially in a situation like this. This is simply rare in the world. Is this still the woman who was playing tricks and rolling around yesterday? Why doesn't it look like it?
Officer Chen responded quickly and said directly: "Liu Guixiang, Cao Tianci. What are you doing? What kind of trick is this. I warn you. You must speak responsibly. All your words have been recorded. This has nothing to do with Brother Gao and the others."
These words sounded as if they were defending Liu Guixiang and the others. This is actually a confirmation. As long as Cao Tianci and his son confirm again. Then it would be useless even if he changed his mind again. Regardless of whether there is surveillance video or not, whether there are witnesses or not. As something that the parties admit without any coercion, it can be used as evidence.
Cao Tianci smiled bitterly, he wanted to blackmail him. But this kid from the Gao family is too evil. He was tortured all night last night. Foaming at the mouth. The image of his whole body twitching was still fresh in his memory. Can this still be blackmail? I'm afraid that if you have a life to make money, you won't be able to spend it.
"Team Chen, you are joking. We are serious. I have really wronged Uncle Gao these days. I am also a bastard. I did some things I shouldn't have done and said some things I shouldn't have said. Please forgive me, Uncle Gao." Cao Tianci apologized repeatedly.
Officer Chen said no more, but nodded and said: "Okay, let me write the mediation agreement. What do you want?"
Cao Tianci immediately said: "No, there is no demand. We will pay the 20,000 yuan for my mother's hospitalization ourselves. In addition, to express our apology. I am willing to compensate Uncle Gao 30,000 yuan."
As Officer Chen began to negotiate the mediation agreement, Cao Tianci, mother and son also got up. Cao Tianci came closer to Gao Shan at this moment, looked at Gao Shan cautiously, and said: "Brother Gao... look..."
Gao Shan smiled and said: "What do I see? Since you said so, I naturally have no objection. If you do more good deeds in the future, there will naturally be no problems."
Having said this, Gao Shan patted Cao Tianci on the shoulder, walked up to Liu Guixiang, patted Liu Guixiang lightly on the shoulder, and said with a half-smile, "Mrs. Liu, you need to be clearer in the future. It will not be good if you blackmail people again."
Gao Shan will not feel embarrassed. Evil will be punished with evil, just like the mentality of these two mother and son. This is considered light.
